name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
briefDescription: PM SVANidhi gives street vendors collateral-free working-capital loans — starting at ₹15,000 and rising to ₹25,000 and ₹50,000 — with a 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.
descriptionMd: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) is a central scheme of the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, launched on 1 June 2020 to help street vendors restart and grow their businesses. It offers **collateral-free working-capital loans**, an interest subsidy, and rewards for going digital, while helping bring vendors — hawkers, thelewalas, rehriwalas and other small sellers — into the formal economy.
benefitsMd:
### Working-capital loan
- **1st loan:** up to **₹15,000**, repayable within 12 months.
- **2nd loan:** up to **₹25,000**, repayable within 18 months.
- **3rd loan:** up to **₹50,000**, repayable within 36 months.
- Each higher loan unlocks on timely or early repayment of the previous one, and there is **no prepayment penalty**.

### Interest subsidy
- A **7% per year** interest subsidy on the loan, credited to your bank account every quarter.
- Available only on standard (non-NPA) accounts, and valid up to **31 March 2033**.

### Digital-transaction cashback
- Earn cashback of **up to ₹100 a month** for accepting digital payments.

The scheme also comes with credit-guarantee support for the lending banks.
eligibilityMd:
The scheme is for street vendors who fall into any of these groups:

- Vendors holding a **Certificate of Vending or Identity Card** issued by an Urban Local Body (ULB).
- Vendors identified in the ULB survey but **not yet issued** a Certificate of Vending / ID Card.
- Vendors left out of the survey, or who started vending after it, who hold a **Letter of Recommendation (LoR)** from the ULB or Town Vending Committee (TVC).
- Vendors from surrounding peri-urban or rural areas who sell within the ULB's limits and hold an **LoR** from the ULB / TVC.
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Go to the official portal at [pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in](https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/) and click **'Log In'**.
**Step 2:** Enter your **mobile number** and the captcha, then request an **OTP**.
**Step 3:** After logging in, select your **vendor category** and enter your **Survey Reference Number (SRN)**, which is mandatory.
**Step 4:** Complete the application form online, upload the required documents and submit.

For a detailed walkthrough, the portal also provides a step-by-step user manual.
